Nintendo Switch 2

Handheld and TV play

Nintendo Switch 2 system

Hardware details
Processor
Custom NVIDIA processor
Storage
256 GB UFS; system software uses part of it
Built-in display
7.9-inch LCD, 1920 × 1080, HDR10
Display capability
Up to 120 Hz on the built-in screen; game support varies
TV output
Up to 4K at 60 Hz; 1080p/1440p output can support 120 Hz
Game storage expansion
microSD Express required for game storage

Exact CPU core configuration and clocks are not disclosed in the cited Nintendo specification.
